Jul 30 and Aug 1 are treated as adjacent days in hot-run detection and gap joining.","cite":["C2:L37-L38","C3:L34","C3:L37-L56"]}]},"summary":"The mask comes from C3: baseline SST for May 12 to Sep 19 of each year 1992-2002 (C2) gives hazen 90th-percentile pools, which are smoothed into thresholds and compared with 2003 target SST, then hot runs of 5+ days are found and gaps of 1-2 days joined. The target list in C2 omits the 31st of July and August, so only 90 days (through 2003-08-30, without Jul 31) reach the mask."}
